subject: Pricing validation: $/1M token targets & PO threshold — follow-up
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@orchard.ai>, Alex Wright <alex@orchard.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & numbers from today's discovery — target $/1M tokens and procurement path

Hi Sam / Alex —

Thanks again for a constructive call today. Quick recap of the pieces we agreed to validate and next steps so your procurement team has the numbers they need: 

Summary (items for validation):
- Estimated monthly traffic: ~120M–350M input+output tokens (chat-heavy workload; ~2.2M sessions/month estimated).
- Target unit economics you mentioned in the call: target $/1M tokens in the $12–$22 range for committed volumes.
- Preferred procurement path: PO for committed monthly > $10k; credit-card ok for pilot/POC under $10k.

What I'm attaching: provisional pricing sheet with three bands and an example calc ("Redwood_Provisional_Pricing_1M_token_breakdown.xlsx"), and a draft mutual action plan so we can align procurement steps and target dates.

Ask / next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the monthly spend band you expect to target on go-live (pick one): $2k–$9k / $10k–$39k / $40k+? Reply with the band and whether a PO is required for your billing.
2) Confirm whether your workload includes a substantial portion of embeddings / reranking (those change the per-token mix).
3) If PO required, what is your typical internal approval lead time (2–6 weeks, 6–12 weeks, 12+ weeks)?

If helpful we can lock a provisional committed price for a 3-month ramp with a minimum monthly commit to meet your $/1M target — I put a sample below so you have a quick reference.

Sample calc (provisional):
- Hosted baseline: $35 per 1M tokens
- Committed 3-mo band (example): 120M–350M tokens/month -> price we can provisionally offer: $18 / 1M tokens (volume-weighted).
- Effective monthly spend at 200M tokens: 200 * $18 / 1M = $3,600 per month.

I don't want to over-promise — final price depends on model variant, caching opportunities, and whether you opt for Reserved (Dedicated) capacity. Aditya, please see notes below on technical levers.

Happy to hop on a short follow-up with procurement if you'd like — I can bring our finance/contract lead.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Sam —

Thanks, good questions. Short answers inline below and attached is a provisional, redline-friendly quote (Quote_RW-ORCH-0421.pdf) plus the pricing sheet.

- Token mix: the $18 / 1M provisional example assumes chat tokens (prompt + response) counted together; embedding calls are priced differently on the sheet. If your workload is ~90% chat, that example is applicable.

- PO threshold flexibility: yes — we can create committed tiers a) pilot (month-to-month) under $10k, b) committed tier aligned to $15k/month PO threshold (we can set the commitment floor at $15k), c) enterprise reserved capacity for $40k+/month with SLA. We'll document this in the MAP.

- 250M tokens example (provisional calc with commited price): 
  * Committed price used: $16 / 1M tokens (volume band fall-through pricing for stable 3-mo commit)
  * Effective monthly spend = (250 * $16) / 1,000 = $4,000/month

Notes & caveats: final effective price can improve if we enable prefix caching (helps for repetitive prompts) and if you accept a model-variant that is quantized for lower cost. Aditya: see technical details below (copied for the customer's awareness).

Next steps I suggest: 
- Sam: confirm PO threshold (you indicated $15k) and whether you want a 3-month ramped commit or a 12-month reserved contract by EOW next week.
- Alex: share procurement contact and preferred billing entity so our finance team can draft the PO-ready paperwork.

Linking HubSpot deal and attached docs. I can introduce our contracts lead on the next thread if that helps.

Best,
Neha
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Follow-up & numbers from today's discovery — technical levers to hit $/1M target

Hi all — quick technical notes to accompany the commercial calc: 

- Typical win levers we recommend for chat-heavy workloads: 
  1) Prefix/KV caching — if >30% of prompts reuse system or instruction text, this can reduce tokens billed by 10–30% for responses that re-use context.
  2) Model-variant selection — moving from base LLM to a quantized 8-bit variant reduces per-token execution cost; we can qualify for your accuracy requirements with a small eval set.
  3) Batching & concurrency — for high throughputs (200M+ tokens/month) configuring continuous batching improves GPU utilization and lowers unit cost (applies to Hosted and Dedicated).

- To finalize TO-BE pricing I need a short sample: 2–3 representative prompts and an estimate of request concurrency (peak qps). If you'd rather, share 24 hours of anonymized logs and we can run a quick sim.

Happy to run a short eval on a 1k-query sample to estimate realized $/1M after caching and batching.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
